name: Sagara Tenma
source: A guy who was being saved by Houou in the past and aspires him to go in the same path by attending Shishiku Academy. Despite being a 1st Year, he's already blessed with overwhelming physical strength. Has a blunt personality which sometimes doesn't care about his surrounding.
